Terms and Conditions

These terms and conditions explain the rules, responsibilities, and guidelines for using our website and telehealth mental health services.

Introduction

Welcome to LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry. These Terms and Conditions govern your use of this website and telehealth mental health services. By accessing this website or scheduling services, you agree to comply with these terms.

If you do not agree with these terms, please discontinue use of the website and services.

Use of Website

This website is intended to provide general information about mental health services, telehealth appointments, and practice policies.

You agree to use this website only for lawful purposes and not to:

  • Attempt unauthorized access to systems

  • Interfere with website functionality

  • Submit false or misleading information

  • Use content without permission

All website content is provided for informational purposes only and does not replace professional medical advice.

Telehealth Services

Telehealth services are provided through our scheduling and telehealth video provider. By scheduling an appointment, you agree to participate in telehealth services voluntarily.

You are responsible for:

  • Providing accurate personal information

  • Attending scheduled appointments on time

  • Maintaining a private and secure location for sessions

Telehealth services may not be appropriate for emergency situations. If you are experiencing an emergency, please contact emergency services immediately.

Appointment Scheduling and Cancellation

Appointments must be scheduled through approved booking methods. Cancellation and rescheduling policies will be provided during the scheduling process.

Failure to attend scheduled appointments without notice may result in applicable fees or scheduling restrictions.

Privacy and Confidentiality

Your privacy is important. All personal and health information is handled in accordance with applicable privacy laws and the Privacy Policy.

However, electronic communication may involve limited risk despite security safeguards.

Limitation of Liability

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry is not responsible for technical interruptions, internet issues, or third-party service failures that may affect access to telehealth services.

Website content is provided without warranties of any kind.

Changes to Terms

These Terms and Conditions may be updated periodically. Updated versions will be posted on this page with a revised effective date.

Continued use of services indicates acceptance of updated terms.

Contact Information

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact:

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry

Phone: (407) 603 – 1717

Frequently Asked Questions

Find answers to common questions about telehealth mental health services, appointments, insurance, fees, and how to get started with care.

What is telehealth mental health care?

Telehealth mental health care allows you to receive therapy, psychiatric evaluation, and medication management through secure video appointments instead of in-person visits.

How do I schedule an appointment?

You can schedule an appointment using the online booking system. After scheduling, you will receive confirmation and instructions for your telehealth session.

Do you accept insurance?

We accept select insurance plans. Please contact us or visit the Fees & Insurance page to verify coverage and payment options.

Are telehealth sessions confidential?

Yes. All telehealth sessions are conducted through secure, HIPAA-compliant platforms to protect your privacy and confidentiality.

What do I need for a telehealth appointment?

You will need a stable internet connection, a computer, tablet, or smartphone, and a private location for your session.

Can I reschedule or cancel my appointment?

Yes. Appointments can be rescheduled or canceled according to the cancellation policy. Please contact us in advance to make changes.

Telehealth Mental Health SMS Consent and Communication Policy

This policy explains how SMS and electronic communications are used to support your telehealth mental health care, including appointment reminders, updates, and important service notifications.

Purpose of SMS Communication

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry may use SMS (text messaging) and electronic communication to provide important information related to your care. These communications are intended to improve convenience, appointment attendance, and timely coordination of services.

SMS messages may include appointment reminders, scheduling confirmations, and general service-related notifications.

SMS communication is optional and requires your consent.

Consent to Receive SMS Messages

By providing your phone number and opting in, you consent to receive SMS messages related to your telehealth mental health services. Consent may be provided through online forms, appointment scheduling systems, or written agreement.

Providing consent is voluntary and not required to receive services.

Types of Messages You May Receive

If you opt in, you may receive:

  • Appointment reminders

  • Appointment confirmations

  • Scheduling updates

  • Service notifications

  • Administrative messages related to your care

SMS messages will not include detailed personal health information whenever possible.

Message Frequency

Message frequency may vary depending on your appointment schedule and service needs. Most patients receive only occasional messages related to appointments or administrative updates.

Privacy and Confidentiality

We take appropriate steps to protect your privacy. However, SMS communication may not be fully secure, and there is a small risk that messages could be viewed by others with access to your phone.

For sensitive or detailed health information, secure telehealth platforms or direct communication methods will be used instead.

Opting Out of SMS Communication

You may opt out of SMS communication at any time by:

  • Replying “STOP” to any message

  • Contacting our office directly

  • Requesting removal from SMS communication lists

Once you opt out, you will no longer receive SMS messages except where required for administrative or legal purposes.

Standard Messaging Rates

Standard message and data rates may apply based on your mobile carrier plan. LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry is not responsible for carrier charges.

Contact Information

If you have questions about this SMS consent and communication policy, please contact:

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry

Phone: (407) 603 – 1717

Telehealth Mental Health Accessibility Statement

We are committed to ensuring that our telehealth mental health services and website remain accessible, inclusive, and easy to use for all individuals, including those with disabilities.

Our Commitment to Accessibility

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry is dedicated to providing an accessible and inclusive experience for all patients and website visitors. We strive to ensure that everyone, regardless of ability, can access information, schedule appointments, and receive telehealth mental health services without barriers.

Accessibility is an ongoing priority, and we continuously work to improve usability and accessibility across our website and telehealth platforms.

Accessibility Features

To support accessibility, we aim to:

  • Provide clear and readable website content

  • Maintain consistent navigation throughout the website

  • Use accessible color contrast for readability

  • Support keyboard navigation where possible

  • Ensure compatibility with screen readers and assistive technologies

  • Provide alternative text for important images

These features help improve the experience for individuals using assistive devices.

Telehealth Accessibility

Our telehealth platform is designed to be accessible across multiple devices, including computers, tablets, and smartphones. Virtual sessions can be accessed from home, providing flexibility and convenience.

If you require accommodations to participate in telehealth services, please contact us in advance so appropriate arrangements can be made.

Ongoing Improvements

We are committed to continually reviewing and improving our website to enhance accessibility. As technology evolves, we aim to implement updated accessibility standards and best practices.

Feedback from users plays an important role in helping us identify and resolve accessibility concerns.

Third-Party Content

Some areas of the website may use third-party tools or platforms, such as scheduling systems or telehealth software. While we strive to work with accessible providers, we cannot guarantee accessibility for third-party services.

Need Assistance?

If you experience difficulty accessing any part of this website or need assistance, please contact us. We will make every reasonable effort to provide the information or support you need.

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry
Email: info@lifewellfhp.com
Phone: (407) 603 – 1717

Telehealth Mental Health Privacy Policy

Your privacy and confidentiality are a top priority. This telehealth mental health privacy policy explains how your personal and health information is collected, used, and protected when you access our services or communicate through secure telehealth platforms.

Introduction

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry is committed to protecting your privacy and maintaining the confidentiality of your personal and health information. This Privacy Policy explains how information is collected, used, stored, and protected when you visit our website, schedule appointments, or receive telehealth mental health services.

By using this website or our services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

Information We Collect

We may collect the following types of information:

Personal Information:
Name, email address, phone number, and other contact details provided through forms or appointment scheduling.

Health Information:
Information related to your mental health, medical history, and treatment necessary to provide appropriate care.

Technical Information:
IP address, browser type, device information, and website usage data collected automatically for security and performance purposes.

How Your Information Is Used

Your information may be used to:

  • Schedule and manage appointments

  • Provide telehealth mental health services

  • Communicate regarding your care

  • Respond to inquiries

  • Improve website functionality

  • Maintain security and prevent unauthorized access

  • Comply with legal and regulatory requirements

Your information will never be sold to third parties.

Confidentiality and Data Protection

We follow professional and legal standards designed to protect your health information. Telehealth sessions and electronic communications are conducted using encrypted connections through our scheduling and telehealth providers.

Access to your information is limited to authorized personnel involved in your care.

Information Sharing

Your information may only be shared when:

  • Required by law

  • Necessary for treatment, payment, or healthcare operations

  • Authorized by you through written consent

  • Needed to protect your safety or the safety of others

We do not share personal information for marketing purposes.

Data Security

We implement appropriate technical and administrative safeguards to protect your information from unauthorized access, loss, misuse, or disclosure.

While we take reasonable precautions, no online system can guarantee complete security.

Your Rights

You have the right to:

  • Request access to your personal information

  • Request corrections to inaccurate information

  • Request restrictions on certain uses of your information

  • Withdraw consent when applicable

Requests may be submitted using the contact information below.

Third-Party Services

This website may use secure third-party platforms for appointment scheduling, analytics, or communication. These providers are required to maintain appropriate privacy and security standards.

Changes to This Policy

This privacy policy may be updated periodically. Any changes will be posted on this page with an updated effective date.

Contact Information

If you have questions about this Privacy Policy or how your information is handled, please contact:

LifeWell Family Health & Psychiatry
Email: info@lifewellfhp.com
Phone: (407) 603 – 1717

Lourdie Chachoute, FNP-C, PMHNP-BC, RRT, CCRN

Short Biography

I am a dual-certified Family Nurse Practitioner and Psychiatric-Mental Health Nurse Practitioner dedicated to providing compassionate, holistic, and evidence-based care. My philosophy is simple: mental health is health. I believe true wellness requires caring for the whole person — mind and body — in a safe, respectful, and judgment-free environment where you feel heard and supported.

With over 15 years of diverse clinical experience in critical care, primary care, respiratory therapy, and mental health, I bring a well-rounded perspective to patient care. I specialize in diagnosing and treating anxiety, depression, ADHD, mood disorders, trauma-related conditions, and sleep disturbances. I also integrate women’s health support, weight management, and chronic disease management into my practice, allowing me to address both emotional and physical health needs in a coordinated way.

I earned my Bachelor of Science in Nursing from the University of Central Florida, my Master of Science in Nursing from South University, and a post-master’s certificate from Walden University. I am currently pursuing my Doctor of Nursing Practice degree to further enhance the quality of care I provide.

My approach combines comprehensive evaluation, thoughtful medication management, lifestyle guidance, and patient education. I work collaboratively with you to develop a personalized treatment plan focused on resilience, balance, and long-term well-being.
